verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt file at docs.github.com (HTTP 200) with a GitHub Docs summary header, so a user can point an agent at it. However, the evidence is a single truncated probe. Its full contents, structure and upkeep are unproven, and no first-party documentation describes agent-oriented docs or how agents should use them. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, evidence of the file's full contents and coverage (e.g. llms-full.txt or markdown page variants), and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents consume it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
